item.title: Surveillance Pricing: Exploiting Information Asymmetries
item.description:
📝 While corporations have access to data brokers, online behavioral advertising, and algorithms that can adjust prices in real time, consumers are more disempowered than ever. Laws mandating disclosure may leave consumers more informed, but they fail to lower prices and prevent companies from amassing personal data. The Algorithmic Pricing Disclosure Act requires companies that set prices using an algorithm based on consumers’ personal data to display a disclosure stating, “THIS PRICE WAS SET BY AN ALGORITHM USING YOUR PERSONAL DATA.
🔗 Read more: https://lpeproject.org/blog/surveillance-pricing-exploiting-information-asymmetries/
